id.description: A kebab-case identifier, unique within its catalog.

ref.description: Where the thing lives: a bare URL, or `{ name, url }` when the author has a better name for it than its address.

name.description: The label a figure prints for this entry.

description.description: Markdown the drawer renders when a reader stops on this entry.

refs.description: Links to where this lives — one meaning wherever the field appears.

note.description: The one line a figure can afford to print beside this entry.

tool.description: The id of a tool in the Tooling catalog. Optional: a step driven with three things open is still delegated.

level.description: Where the human stands: `manual` (person does it), `assisted` (tool helps, person drives), `delegated-review` (tool does it, person reviews), `gated-autonomous` (tool does it, a gate stops it), `autonomous` (tool does it unattended).

usage.description: How the tool is used *here* — advice true of this activity, not of the tool everywhere.

asset.description: The concrete thing this use is configured by — a prompt, a config file, a template.

fill.description: The activity is filled: something does this work today, at a stated delegation level.

tool.description: The id of the tool being recommended.

level.description: The level this tool would reach here, if adopted.

event.description: The id of an event that is the moment to reach for this.

usage.description: How this tool would be used here.

recommendation.description: A pointer from this activity to a tool it could use. Never fills the slot — an activity with ten of these is still open.

need.description: What this slot wants — the sentence only the team can write. Required: a slot with nothing to say is a blank, not a slot.

openSlot.description: The activity is open: work the team has decided to hand to a tool and has not yet. A roadmap item, drawn as a dashed box.

harness.description: The id of the harness this tool runs in.

kind.description: What sort of thing it is — a skill, a command, an agent, a check.

note.description: Advice that holds wherever this tool is used. Advice true in only one activity belongs on that recommendation instead.

roles.description: Ids of the roles who do this step. At least one.

consumes.description: Ids of the artifacts this step reads. Half of an arrow — the other half is a `produces` somewhere else.

produces.description: Ids of the artifacts this step leaves behind. At least one; this is what arrows are derived from.

why.description: Why the step exists — the reason a reader would otherwise have to ask for.

tooling.description: The activity is filled: something does this work today, at a stated delegation level.

open.description: The activity is open: work the team has decided to hand to a tool and has not yet. A roadmap item, drawn as a dashed box.

recommends.description: Tools this step could use. Does not fill it.

activities.description: A sub-process: steps inside this step, using the same roles and artifacts.

note.description: The one line the masthead prints and the page hands to `<meta>`.

description.description: Markdown the drawer renders: what this document assumes and how it wants to be read.

version.description: The document version, as the team numbers it.

status.description: `draft` while the document describes how the session went; `living` once it describes how the team actually works.

roles.description: The lanes every figure is drawn along. Always here, never a file of their own.

artifacts.description: The named things work leaves behind. Here, or in `artifacts.yaml` — never both.

harnesses.description: The runtimes the team has. Here, or in `harnesses.yaml` — never both.

events.description: The recurring moments a recommendation can be attached to. Here, or in `events.yaml` — never both.

tools.description: The concrete things inside a harness that activities name. Here, or in `tools.yaml` — never both.
